_help: How Starling answers questions about Elite ships (0.77.0). {ship} is the ship's name; the other words in {braces} are filled in from config/ships_specs.json. A line is only used when she has every value in it. 'heard_as' fixes ships the listening model often mishears.
cost_insurance: A {ship} is {cost}, and the rebuy is {insurance}.
insurance: If you lose a {ship}, the rebuy is {insurance}.
jump: The {ship} jumps {jump_stock} light years as it comes, and {jump_best} fully upgraded.
{jump_stock} light years stock. {jump_best} once it is fully upgraded.
hardpoints: The {ship} has {weapons} weapon hardpoints: {weapon_breakdown}. It also has {utility} utility mounts.
{weapons} hardpoints on the {ship}: {weapon_breakdown}. Plus {utility} utility mounts.
cargo: The {ship} carries {cargo_stock} tonnes as it comes, and up to {cargo_max} tonnes fully fitted.
{cargo_max} tonnes at most on the {ship}. {cargo_stock} stock.
speed: The {ship}'s top speed is {speed_stock} metres per second, or {speed_best} upgraded.
boost: The {ship} boosts at {boost_stock} metres per second, or {boost_best} upgraded.
{boost_stock} metres per second on a boost, {boost_best} upgraded.
mass: The {ship} has a hull mass of {mass} tonnes.
A {ship} weighs {mass} tonnes before you load it.
armour: The {ship} has {armour} armour, with a hardness of {hardness}.
manoeuvre: The {ship}'s manoeuvrability rating is {manoeuvrability}. The higher the number, the nimbler it is.
Manoeuvrability {manoeuvrability} for the {ship}. Higher means nimbler.
heat: The {ship} has a heat capacity of {heat}.
year: {years_start} is when the {ship} first came out.
summary: The {ship} is a {role} ship from {manufacturer}. It needs a {pad} pad, costs {cost}, jumps up to {jump_best} light years and carries up to {cargo_max} tonnes. It has {weapons} weapon hardpoints.
{ship}: {role}, built by {manufacturer}. {pad} landing pad, {cost}. Up to {jump_best} light years a jump, up to {cargo_max} tonnes of cargo, and {weapons} weapon hardpoints.
summary_more: Ask me about its cost, jump range, hardpoints or cargo if you want more.
unknown: I don't have that for the {ship}.
That one isn't in my notes for the {ship}.
count: I have {count} ships in my notes, from the Sidewinder to the newest Odyssey ones.
super_max: {names[0]} leads with {values[0]}, then {names[1]} with {values[1]} and {names[2]} with {values[2]}.
super_min: {names[0]} is lowest at {values[0]}, then {names[1]} at {values[1]} and {names[2]} at {values[2]}.
super_cost_max: The most expensive is the {names[0]} at {values[0]}, then the {names[1]} at {values[1]} and the {names[2]} at {values[2]}.
super_cost_min: The cheapest is the {names[0]} at {values[0]}, then the {names[1]} at {values[1]} and the {names[2]} at {values[2]}.
no_my_ship: I don't know which ship you're in yet. Load into the game and ask me again.
